Teaching experience

Machine Learning I. Department of Computer Science, Polytechnic University of Catalonia — Spring 2022–2025

Taught sessions for second-year Data Science students covering data preprocessing, regularization, clustering, decision trees, ensemble methods, and resampling techniques.

Programming I. Department of Computer Science, Polytechnic University of Catalonia — Spring 2022–2024

Taught weekly sessions covering C++ fundamentals, including syntax, data types, control structures, and introductory problem-solving.

Applied Programming for the Life Sciences. Department of Computer Science, Polytechnic University of Catalonia — Spring and Fall 2024

Taught theory and laboratory sessions for the inaugural edition of the course. Topics included object-oriented programming, algorithms, complexity analysis, and optimization.

Programming and Algorithms I. Polytechnic University of Catalonia — Fall 2021–2023

Taught foundational Python programming to first-year Industrial Engineering and Bioinformatics students.

Programming and Algorithms I. Pompeu Fabra University — Fall 2017–2024

Organized and taught a preparatory course covering Bash, Linux, and Python, and provided supplementary support sessions throughout the semester.
